newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 100 MW peak power at $17.50-18.50/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 100 MW peak power at $17.50-18.50/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 100 megawatts (MW) of peak, firm power for Tuesday at $17.50 for Northwest and $18.50 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales, the agency said Monday.
The agency's other price offers were unchanged.

BPA continued to offer non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 and 2300 PDT on Tuesday at $9.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and COB deliveries, while delivered prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 were flat at $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Tuesday was also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
